pipeline: Mounted rendered stereo/RGBD + camera calibration -> cuVSLAM VO and SLAM backend

Four lidar scan-to-CAD registration -> map/odom correction; all four lidars -> Nav2 obstacles and velocity guard
Rendered depth + estimated pose -> nvBlox ESDF
Known CAD occupancy + nvBlox + lidar -> Nav2 Navfn planner -> geometric holonomic follower -> bounded swerve actuator

required_feedback.fusion: Calibrate and synchronize each IMU, transform to base_link including lever arm, reject outliers, fuse once with wheel odometry and visual odometry. Avoid double-counting IMU-fed cuVSLAM.

motion_envelope.scope: Provisional flat-floor, source mass, arm home, no payload. PPO wheel scaling and steering transients mean command bounds are not measured chassis-acceleration guarantees. Emergency stops override slew limits.
